title: Design: Vendor card shows a deactivated term as Inactive
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure vendor A is on Net 50, and Net 50 is deactivated.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design pictures ct-p7-05-vendor-page-today.png, ct-p7-06-vendor-on-a-deactivated-term.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Vendors page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open vendor A.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The vendor card shows "Credit term" with "Net 50 (Inactive)" under it, whole, in the same place and style as today's card (compare ct-p7-06-vendor-on-a-deactivated-term.png and today's ct-p7-05-vendor-page-today.png).

Step 2:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R3: “A vendor on a deactivated term shows "{name} (Inactive)" on the vendor card's "Credit term" and selected in Edit Vendor, listed after the active terms, until someone picks another.”
  • S6-R6: “Term names are never cut off in the vendor Credit Terms dropdown or on the vendor card, including with "(Inactive)"; long names wrap.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "7 Vendors" ("Vendor page today", "Vendor on a deactivated term").
